newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT surges to new calendar '97 high.
newsitem.headline: NTT surges to new calendar '97 high.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp surged to a new calendar 1997 high in late Tuesday morning trade, surpassing its initial offer price, brokers said.

As of 0135 GMT, the shares were up 40,000 yen at a new high of 1.2 million yen, 3,000 yen above the 1.197 million yen initial offer price of the privatised firm's shares which were offered to the public in 1987.
Brokers said investors were resuming purchases of the shares in expectations that NTT will become the core company in the information technology sector.
